mean_verification_time.instruction: Estimate the mean verification runtime for the published four-bidder, six-product simultaneous multi-round auction model on its source execution setup.
mean_verification_time.field_description: bidder_capacities: ordered capacities of bidders 1 through 4, each the maximum number of products the bidder may win; property_price: queried price in source auction price units; property_product: queried product identifier; property_winner: queried bidder, with 0 indicating a price-only property. Verification outcome is not available as input.
